title: From a Quiet Sofa to a Cat's Busy Day
caption:
FROM SOFA REST TO PLAY. Original narration over independently filmed real cats. Sources and creators credited with each approved release. #WildVox #Cats #CatBehavior

narration_timeline.text: A cat rests on a sofa, but stillness is only one part of its daily routine.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Cat relaxing on a sofa.webm

narration_timeline.text: In a different home, another cat explores a paper bag and peers into the opening.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Cat in a Bag.webm

narration_timeline.text: Outside, a black cat walks across the ground, while a separate cat carefully cleans its fur.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Black Cat walking.webm and Cat behaviour - self-grooming.webm

narration_timeline.text: Two cats play together indoors, while another cat rolls and stretches on the floor.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Larry the cat and Chloé playing (100111224612).webm and Cat playing in Taiwan.webm

narration_timeline.text: Elsewhere, a cat reaches toward a small object, exploring it with its front paws.
Finally, a cat enjoys a person's gentle attention outside, closing this story on a calmer note.
